Method of Attack: Installing backdoored plugins via Jetpack plugin remote management feature
Deploying backdoored plugins that are invisible on target WordPress sites but visible on WordPress.com dashboard
Redirecting users to spam and tech support scams
Impacted Systems: Self-hosted WordPress sites using Jetpack plugin connected to WordPress.com accounts
Attack Vector: Compromise of weakly protected WordPress.com accounts via credential stuffing
Abuse of Jetpack plugin's remote management feature to install malicious plugins
